$comment: D-ASM-DIALECTS-DECLARE-A-REGISTER-CLASS-NO-INSTRUCTION-CAN-NAME — the LAST three gaps, closed in P54 by lane el and witnessed here by EXECUTION. ★★★ THE ONE THAT NEEDED RUNNING: two of the three gaps failed LOUD (an unknown mnemonic, a parse error), so a build-only arm goes green the moment any row exists. The third was SILENT — ✔MEASURED earlier in this same cycle, a width-less `fcvtzs` row compiled `fcvtzs %w0, %s1` rc=0 and emitted `fcvtzs x16, s29` (0x9E3803B0), the X form, where gas 2.42 and clang 18.1.3 both give the W form. A 32-bit destination written and a 64-bit one emitted, with nothing in the build log. ★★★ THE DISCRIMINATOR IS SATURATION, because for any small value the W and X forms agree: AArch64 FCVTZS saturates, so 3.0e9 into a W destination is INT32_MAX and into an X destination is 3000000000 (low 32 bits -1294967296). Shapes 1 and 2 assert each answer and shape 3 asserts they DISAGREE, so neither can be passing over an instruction that never ran. ★★ THE INT->FP DIRECTION IS DISCRIMINATED BY ROUNDING instead: 2^24+1 is exact in binary64 and rounds to 2^24 in binary32, so `scvtf %s0,%w1` and `scvtf %d0,%w1` must disagree on one source integer (shapes 6-7), and `fcvt` narrowing repeats it across the FP widths (shapes 9-10). ★★ THE ARRANGEMENT SHAPES COMPUTE A POPULATION COUNT — the only thing the two declared SIMD spellings can do — threading one integer through `fmov` (GPR->SIMD), `cnt`, `addv` and `fmov` back (SIMD->GPR), which also makes the CROSS-FILE `fmov` load-bearing in BOTH directions and at BOTH widths (shapes 11-14). Shape 16 repeats the chain over SIXTEEN lanes: `fmov %d0,%x1` zeroes bits 64..127, so the Q=1 word must give the same total, which is what proves it ran rather than counted stale bits. ⚠⚠ NOT ONE SHAPE IS A COPY, AND THAT IS MEASURED: an inline-asm `fmov %d0, %d1` reaches the binary as ZERO INSTRUCTIONS, because copy coalescing puts source and destination in one register and `classifyIdentityClassMove` deletes the identity move. Every template here changes a value's WIDTH, its BANK, or its BITS. ⚠ `volatile` seeds are load-bearing: the release arm must still reach the templates. ⚠ ARM64 SPECS ONLY — the subject is one dialect's instruction table and one target's encodings. Exit codes name the failing shape.
